paper.title: Online Learning to Rank with Feedback at the Top

settings.name_in_paper: Online learning to rank with top-k feedback (convex surrogates)
unmapped: Learner outputs a score vector in R^m over m documents (side information X_t in R^{m x d}); only relevances of the top-k ranked documents are revealed; loss is a ranking surrogate phi(s, R_t) evaluated on the full unrevealed relevance vector
Comparator is the best linear scoring function w with ||w||_2 <= U; learner knows U and R_D (feature norm bound)
Relevance vectors in {0,...,n}^m, chosen by oblivious adversary
settings.definition_quote: We formalize the problem as a game being played between a learner and an oblivious adversary over T rounds. The learner's action set is the uncountably infinite set of score vectors in R^m ... The adversary then generates a relevance vector R_t but only reveals the relevance of top k ranked documents to the learner ... E[sum_t phi(tilde s_t,R_t)] - min_{||w||_2 <= U} sum_t phi(X_t w, R_t)

settings.name_in_paper: Online learning to rank with top-1 feedback, NDCG calibrated surrogates (lower bound)
unmapped: Learner outputs score vectors ranking m documents; only relevance of the top-ranked document is revealed; loss is any NDCG-calibrated surrogate evaluated on full relevance vector
Comparator is best linear scoring function with ||w||_2 <= U
settings.definition_quote: Fix the online learning to rank game with top-1 feedback and any NDCG calibrated surrogate.

symbols.C_phi: surrogate-dependent polynomial in R_D, m, U, R_max (C^sq = m^4 R_D^4 U^2 R_max^2, C^svm = O(m^4 R_D^2), C^KL = m^2 R_D^2 exp(2 R_D U))

conditions: surrogate is one of squared loss (top-1 feedback), modified ListNet KL surrogate (top-1 feedback) or RankSVM hinge surrogate (top-2 feedback)
feature vectors bounded by R_D in l2 norm

source.label: theoryboundinpartial
source.quote: For any sequence of instances and labels $(X_t,R_t)_{\{t \in [T]\}}$, applying Alg.~\ref{alg:RTop-kF} with top-1 feedback for $\phi_{sq}$ and $\phi_{KL}$ and top-2 feedback for $\phi_{svm}$, will produce the following bound on the regret for any of the three surrogates: ... \le C^{\phi} O(T^{2/3})

results.notes: Regret against best linear ranker with ||w||<=U; expectation over learner randomization against oblivious adversary. C^KL is exponential in R_D U despite lemma statement saying polynomial.

conditions: loss is any NDCG calibrated surrogate (with unique minimizer)
construction uses m=3, X = identity, binary relevance vectors

source.label: impossiblegame
source.quote: Fix the online learning to rank game with top-1 feedback and any NDCG calibrated surrogate. Then, for every learner's algorithm, there exists an adversary strategy s.t. the learner's expected regret is $\Omega(T)$.

results.notes: Adversary in proof draws relevance vectors i.i.d. from a mixture distribution; holds for every learner algorithm.
